modalities.evidence: Taste intensity ratings made on the gLMS

output.population: Right-handed, non-smoking participants, women and men, mean age 27.53 years with a range of 18-38
output.summary: Brain imaging and taste psychophysics in healthy right-handed adults, using sweet, sour, salty, bitter and tasteless stimuli, supporting study of an amygdala-thalamic circuit acting as a central gain mechanism in taste perception.
